gloss: to rival; to be comparable to

definitions.gloss: to rival; to match; to be comparable to; to be on par with
definitions.explanation: To be equal or comparable in quality, scale, or ability to something noteworthy. Often used to emphasize that something reaches the level of something impressive.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{才能|さいのう}に{匹敵|ひってき}する{人|ひと}はいない。
examples.english: No one can match his talent.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}は{名作|めいさく}に{匹敵|ひってき}する{出来|でき}だ。
examples.english: This film is of a quality that rivals the masterpieces.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{台風|たいふう}の{被害|ひがい}は{過去|かこ}{最大|さいだい}の{記録|きろく}に{匹敵|ひってき}するほどだった。
examples.english: This year's typhoon damage was on par with the worst on record.

notes:
Used to express that something reaches the level of something else that is typically impressive or notable. Takes the pattern AはBに{匹敵|ひってき}する (A rivals B / A is comparable to B). Often appears in written or formal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～に{匹敵|ひってき}する{力|ちから}: power comparable to ~
- ～に{匹敵|ひってき}する{規模|きぼ}: a scale rivaling ~
- {匹敵|ひってき}するものがない: unrivaled; without equal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {相当|そうとう}する: to correspond to — more neutral, used for equivalence without the nuance of impressiveness
- {肩|かた}を{並|なら}べる: to stand shoulder to shoulder — idiomatic, implies achieving the same level
- {対抗|たいこう}する: to compete against — implies active rivalry or opposition
